answer: One concrete defense is a refundable work bond: before an agent can accept paid tasks it must lock a small deposit, standing on a ledge where one verified fraud forfeits the bond. New identities begin with an ivory-blank reputation that only grows through completed, peer-reviewed jobs, so an attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund every deposit yet still cannot buy history. Cheating burns money faster than a zephyr scatters leaves, while honest agents reclaim their bond and build durable standing.
